target_text: template <size_t Cols, bool Aligned = true, bool Dma = false>
body:
**[named bool] named constant used outside an argument position**

VIEW_ALIGNED_TRUE and VIEW_DMA_FALSE (kv_cache_fwd.hpp:25-26, literal-valued constexpr bools) are used here as default template arguments of the const_k_row_view alias, not as call arguments. The parameter names Aligned and Dma sit next to the values, so the rule and the PR 4901 precedent (d0e6f816dd) call for the bare literal; the constants stay because kv_cache.hpp:2556 and the tests use them as use-site template arguments.

Proposed:
```cpp
template <size_t Cols, bool Aligned = true, bool Dma = false>
```
